ms.report:
Thank you reviewers for your feedback. There are some points which i hope to clarify.
**You have uploaded a new educational video, due to my fellow reviewer pointing out that the previous one was from December, so the work in it could not have been done as part of this project - but the content in your new video still seems almost identical to the old one (except for a context-setting mention of the Chang hardfork at the start). This leaves things a bit unclear about whether the work really was done as part of this project. Is there any way you can clarify what's different between the video you made in December, and the one you uploaded today? Thanks
Since our last proposal, we have worked with Brothership Pool to update the serialization library of the Cardano wallet connection feature. This has allowed for better wallet connection, as before we had a concern about wallet connection for users that had a lot of utxos. I was able to demonstrate in the new video by connecting my Cardano wallet and also showing the NFTs which were available to be used. Attached are several screenshots of private conversations, hence why they were not included before, which shows the collaboration to update the Cardano wallet serialization library. Please note the date of this conversation, June 2024, which proves that this work was not part of our previous proposal. 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/14MrMZ-q52hWqamsPUFW42M5M0BMeMDRH/view?usp=sharing
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Skok0MBHzJqKxZ7qZzHEYPTgJ21NXduU/view?usp=sharing

Resubmitted as per reviewer request. Please take note of the youtube content provided which shows the blockfrost API connection. Users can see the current epoch, live stake, ada price, etc. Users can also connect a Cardano wallet to the platform. Please reference the current version of the platform https://cardanocalendar.io/calendar 
・A video preview shows Blockfrost API connection and the ability to connect a Cardano wallet to the platform.
